_comment: Copied to <job>/job.json by init_job.py. Fill from the user's answers (SKILL.md Phase 2). Blocks are ids from analysis/ocr.json.

dub.style_instruction: Natural short-video narration. Clear, confident, steady even pace. No long pauses.

_doc.dub.background: separate (demucs removes voice, keeps music) | none | original (only if source has no speech) | file (dub.background_file)
_doc.captions.placement: match_block (center/angle of anchor_block or replace_blocks) | bottom | custom (custom_center = [x,y] fractions)
_doc.captions.size_mode: fixed (line1/line2.size in video pixels) | match (from OCR char height of the anchor block)
_doc.removal.blocks: {"B2": {"mode":"inpaint"}, "B3": {"mode":"blur","strength":25}, "B1": {"mode":"color","color":"#000000","opacity":0.8,"radius":10}, "B4": {"mode":"keep"}}; optional per block: padding_px, mask stroke|box, diff_threshold (30), grow_px (inpaint hole growth, default 0.3 x char height), include_boxes (true), context_px (lama)
_doc.hardware: device auto|cpu|cuda|mps|directml (LaMa, demucs; whisper/OCR pick CUDA themselves); encoder libx264 (default, best quality/size) | auto (first working GPU encoder: h264_nvenc / h264_amf / h264_qsv / h264_videotoolbox) | one of those; threads auto|N; remotion_concurrency auto|N (auto from cores + free RAM); remotion_gl null|angle|egl|swangle. Check this PC: py -3.12 scripts/hw.py
_doc.removal.engine: opencv (built in, fast, smears on large/complex areas) | lama (better, needs simple-lama-inpainting + ~200 MB model, slower)
_doc.watermark.angle_deg: CSS convention: negative = rising to the right
_doc.dub.voice_level_db: voice RMS while speaking (dBFS); music sits background_db_below_voice under it and is ducked duck_db more while the voice speaks; background_volume is an extra multiplier
_doc.target_language: ISO code of the dub/caption language (en default). MiMo preset voices: en Mia/Chloe/Milo/Dean, zh 冰糖/茉莉/苏打/白桦
_doc.dub.style_instruction: natural-language delivery instruction sent to MiMo TTS; dub.speaker_styles {"S2": "..."} overrides per speaker
_doc.dub.target_rate: null = target-language default (en ~2.7 words/s) for check_script budgets, or a number
_doc.dub.min_tempo / max_tempo: allowed time-stretch range per line (0.95-1.10 keeps the pace even)
_doc.dub.min_gap_s / max_early_shift_s: minimum silence between lines; how much earlier than the original a line may start
_doc.dub.voice_volume: extra multiplier on the voice after normalization
_doc.captions.replace_blocks: OCR block ids whose timing/place the new captions take, e.g. ["B2"]; anchor_block = which one sets center/angle (default first)
_doc.captions.rotation_deg: null = angle of the anchor block, else degrees (CSS: positive = clockwise)
_doc.captions.max_width_ratio: max caption width as fraction of video width
_doc.captions.font_family / font_file: CSS font stack; font_file = a .ttf/.otf path (or name in the OS font folders) bundled into the render
_doc.captions.two_lines / max_words_per_line: card layout; words_per_card auto = like the original's words-on-screen
_doc.captions.line1 / line2: size (px, used when size_mode fixed), color, letter_spacing (px)
_doc.captions.lead_frames / bridge_gap_frames: card shows N frames before the word; gaps shorter than this are bridged; minimum card duration
_doc.removal.default: options applied to every block not listed in removal.blocks; removal.padding_px = extra px around OCR boxes
_doc.watermark: enabled, text, opacity 0..1, font_size (px at 1080 wide), font_file, shadow_opacity
_doc.render.crf: x264 quality of the delivered video (17 = visually lossless); concurrency = old name of hardware.remotion_concurrency
_doc.render.remotion_node_modules: null = auto (shared runtime, else search); or path to an existing project's node_modules with remotion 4.x
_doc.output.dir / basename: delivery folder and file name stem (init_job sets basename = <source>_<lang>); empty dir = files stay in the job folder
